name: Blueprint referencing CSV imports
description: Use together with devrev-impl-agent plan/run --csv flags; defaults supply workspace + product context.

ui_guidance.title: Before importing contacts
steps: Ensure each contact row can resolve a rev_org (workspace). Use blueprint.defaults.rev_org or a rev_org column in CSV.
If you only have accounts, create accounts first (CSV accounts entity or blueprint.accounts) then resolve the workspace ID.
